content_sections.heading: About ABV-IIITM
content_sections.text: ABV-Indian Institute of Information Technology & Management Gwalior is an Institute of National Importance under the Ministry of Education, Govt. of India. It is located at NH-10, Morena Link Road, Gwalior, Madhya Pradesh.

content_sections.heading: About the Project
content_sections.text: The project is titled "Intelligent IoT-Based Predictive Maintenance for Industrial Factory Operation" and is funded by Yacca Lifesciences Pvt. Ltd., Roorkee, Uttarakhand. Dr. Pragya Swami, Assistant Prof, EEE, is the Principal Investigator. The selected candidate will help develop and implement an intelligent IoT-based predictive maintenance system for industrial factory operations. The work includes: IoT sensor integration for real-time monitoring of industrial equipment Data acquisition and processing Equipment condition monitoring and analysis of operational parameters Developing AI/ML-based models to identify abnormal operating conditions, detect potential equipment faults and predict maintenance requirements Testing and validating the developed system using industrial data

content_sections.text: Candidates should be either pursuing or should have completed B.Tech./UG in any area related to the project. See the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of this post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications are shortlisted first. Only shortlisted candidates are informed by email about the next stage and the interview date.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The position is initially for six months. It may be renewed quarterly (every three months) based on monthly performance, availability of the fund and subject to the project's duration. The position can be terminated at any point of time. Hybrid work is permitted sometimes, though in-person work is preferred. The work may require travelling for data collection and field testing. Candidates will be required to give progress details to the investigators on a regular basis.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ABV-IIITM Research Assistant/Intern Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Open the online application form . Fill in every part of the form and provide all the documents it asks for. Candidature will not be considered if the form is incomplete or documents are missing. Submit the form before the deadline. Watch your email, as shortlisted candidates are contacted only by that route.

faq.question: Q1. Can I apply if I am still studying for my B.Tech.?
faq.answer: Yes. The position is open to candidates pursuing a B.Tech./UG as well as those who have completed one, as long as the area relates to the project.

faq.question: Q2. Which skills give an applicant an advantage?
faq.answer: Hands-on work in Python, IoT technologies, sensor interfacing and microcontrollers such as Arduino or Raspberry Pi is desirable.

faq.question: Q3. Is the Rs. 6,000 stipend guaranteed every month?
faq.answer: No. It depends on monthly progress assessment, and the authority may reduce, withhold or terminate it.

faq.question: Q4. How long will the position last?
faq.answer: It starts with six months. Any renewal after that comes every three months and depends on performance, funds and the project's duration.

faq.question: Q5. Can the work be done from home?
faq.answer: Hybrid work is permitted sometimes, but the notice prefers in-person work.

faq.question: Q6. Will the position involve travel?
faq.answer: It may. The notice mentions travelling for data collection and field testing.

faq.question: Q7. Who funds the project?
faq.answer: Yacca Lifesciences Pvt. Ltd., Roorkee, Uttarakhand, is the sponsor.

faq.question: Q8. Whom can I contact with a question?
faq.answer: Queries go to Dr. Pragya Swami at [email protected].
